title: The units package exports a new function, with its guard entry

pr.title: Add toMeters to the units package
pr.description: Adds toMeters(), which converts feet to meters, and exports it from the units package. tests/exports.test.ts lists the new export.

traps.why: tests/exports.test.ts lists toMeters in the units entry in the same change, so the new export has its guard. A finding of a missing export test is wrong.
